title: Port scripts/prune-worktrees.sh into susi workflow prune
goal: Reclaiming finished agent worktrees is susi workflow prune (Rust, existing) alone: scripts/prune-worktrees.sh is a stub that execs susi so docs and branches cut before the port keep working; the Rust prune exits non-zero when a removal failed and prunes git's stale admin entries on every run, as the script did; tests/worktree_hygiene.rs pins the behaviour through the stub and the binary, and a Windows test runs with Git's usr/bin off PATH
